chapters.title: CORTEX
chapters.sub: WORKING PROTOTYPE · SYNTHETIC ACOUSTIC INPUT · LIVE MUJOCO SIMULATION
chapters.narration: This is Cortex. This recording uses synthetic vocal profiles to drive a real MuJoCo simulation. The robot is simulated, and the garden is a full 3D waterfall.

chapters.title: Step into the scene.
chapters.sub: FULL 3D GRANITE · ANIMATED WATER · REFLECTIONS · CAMERA PARALLAX
chapters.narration: The camera can move through this scene. Granite, flowing water, the reflecting basin and stone paving all have depth.

chapters.title: “Come here.”
chapters.sub: CALM PROFILE · 0.55 M/S SPEED CEILING · NORMAL APPROACH
chapters.narration: First, the calm profile. Come here. The robot approaches at a moderate pace, with a comfortable stopping distance.

chapters.title: “Come here.”
chapters.sub: IDENTICAL TRANSCRIPT · URGENT PROFILE · 0.90 M/S SPEED CEILING
chapters.narration: Reset. Exactly the same words, with an higher-intensity acoustic profile. Priority rises and the walking policy changes. The feet are driven by Unitree’s frozen locomotion controller.

chapters.title: Same words. Different voice. Different physical policy.
chapters.sub: LOCAL ACOUSTIC CUES · GRADIUM + PIPECAT VOICE → DOCUMENTED MAPPING → SAFETY GOVERNOR → G1
chapters.narration: Reveal Cortex. Measured acoustic cues become a documented behavioral policy. Speed, approach distance and confirmation are explicit. The live microphone path is implemented through Gradium and Pipecat.

chapters.title: Hesitation changes the response, too.
chapters.sub: CAUTIOUS APPROACH · 2.0 M PERSONAL SPACE · CONFIRMATION REQUIRED
chapters.narration: A hesitant acoustic profile does not simply make the robot faster. It holds for confirmation, reduces approach speed, and gives the person more space.

chapters.title: “Where did you last see my backpack?”
chapters.sub: ACTUAL CAPTURED FRAME · OPERATOR-LABELED LOCAL MEMORY · PLANTER
chapters.narration: Now memory. Save the scene, then ask where the backpack was seen. Cortex retrieves the actual captured frame and its registered location, beside the planter.

chapters.title: “Take me there.”
chapters.sub: RETRIEVED EVIDENCE → REGISTERED WAYPOINT → PHYSICAL NAVIGATION
chapters.narration: Take me there. The retrieved sighting becomes a waypoint, and the robot turns toward the planter.

chapters.title: “WAIT! STOP!”
chapters.sub: FAST REFLEX PATH · NO PLANNER ROUND TRIP
chapters.narration: Wait. Stop. The reflex bypasses the planner, latches the stop, and measures acknowledgement and physical settling separately.

chapters.title: “Continue, but slowly.”
chapters.sub: EXPLICIT RESUME · REDUCED 0.30 M/S SPEED CEILING
chapters.narration: Continue, but slowly. A deliberate resume releases the stop and applies a lower speed ceiling. Vocal delivery can change behavior. It can never turn safety off.

chapters.title: CORTEX · Hear the human behind the instruction.
chapters.sub: GRADIUM · PIPECAT · SAMBANOVA · MUJOCO · SOURCE, TESTS & PITCH INCLUDED
chapters.narration: Cortex gives physical AI perception, memory, reasoning, reflexes, and safe action. Gradium handles voice, Pipecat carries the conversation, and SambaNova plans the next safe action.

provenance: Actual application; synthetic acoustic fixtures; live MuJoCo; system-generated narration; full 3D reference-informed waterfall
